correctness.rationale: The finite claim is proved by exhaustive integer double enumeration: 65536 matrix masks, two equivalent membership predicates, 317 symmetry orbits with direct 6902-term signed sums, and independent full Walsh butterfly matching every coefficient. The checker also verifies rank, mod-16 classes, Parseval, minima and 2x2/3x3 baselines. The general support statement follows from published Stirling enumeration and complement pairing.
